name: LEN subsidie en financiering
base: investment incl. 21% VAT (notional VAT applied even at 0% VAT); in the heat-pump example applied after deducting the RVO subsidy
stacking: combinable with ISDE and the Apeldoorn insulation subsidy
eligibility: owners of homes and businesses in Loenen
notes: Cap is per measure. Structural adjustments not eligible. Paired with lef_repayment.

name: Bijdrage Loenens Energie Fonds (LEF)
base: expected annual savings: 13% of investment (PV) or 20% (insulation)
notes: Participant pays 50% of expected annual savings into the revolving fund for 5 years (PV, heat pump) or 3 years (insulation); for PV and heat pump this totals 32,5% of investment incl. VAT. Fund seeded by a one-off EU subsidy of EUR 200.000 (https://loenenenergie.nl/over-loenen-energie-neutraal/).

name: ISDE (Investeringssubsidie duurzame energie en energiebesparing)
base: fixed amount per measure (amount used in the site's examples)
notes: EUR 1.500 is the example amount on the site; a testimonial quotes 'circa EUR 2.500' for listed heat pumps. Actual amounts depend on device and year (check rvo.nl).

name: Subsidie woningisolatie gemeente Apeldoorn
base: insulation works via a home energy adviser; municipality pays the contractor
eligibility: owner-occupier; WOZ value on 1-1-2022 at most EUR 625.000; income below 150% of social minimum; at least two poorly insulated building parts; built in or before 1995
notes: Variants: up to EUR 1.000 back on DIY materials; EUR 1.000 retroactive (invoice at most 12 months old); EUR 1.000, or EUR 1.500 per home for a joint application of at least three addresses in the same or an adjacent 6-digit postcode. Earlier EUR 2.000 recipients can get up to EUR 4.000. The Loenen article says 'tot 100% van de woningisolatie vergoed' and 'tot EUR 500 extra' when neighbours insulate together (https://loenenenergie.nl/isoleren-makkelijker-dan-je-denkt/).

name: Cadeaubon kleine materialen
notes: For small insulation materials; usable in 2026.

name: Begrotingssubsidie aan Energiecoöperatie Loenen
notes: Notice of intent (Gemeenteblad 2026 nr. 355914, 28 juli 2026). Sub-projects: isoleren en besparen; hybridiseren van woningen; duurzame opwek en opslag van elektriciteit. Activities include energy coaches and local pilots for storage and energy sharing, within Wijk van de Toekomst Loenen / WUP aardgasvrij(-ready). Not a per-household subsidy.

name: Achtergestelde obligatielening batterij
base: bond price EUR 50; cap = 100 bonds per member; rate_pct = interest per year, term 10 years
notes: Covers 40% of the battery (~EUR 150.000). Subscription closed 29 May (2026); oversubscribed at circa 133%.

name: Obligaties Zonnedak Thomassen
base: 20% of EUR 690.000; rate_pct = interest per year, term 15 years

name: Interreg NWE cVPP
base: EU share for Stichting Duurzame Projecten Loenen ('ca.')
notes: Total project 6 million EUR; gemeente Apeldoorn share ca. EUR 160.000. Project ran 2017-09-19 to 2020-09-20.

name: Wattflex (DEI+ subsidie)
eligibility: 25 home-battery and 25 smart-charging households (Loenen and Endona/Heeten)
notes: Project reference DEI121070. Participants pay an own contribution and receive a flexibility fee; neither amount is stated.

name: Fonds voor lokale sociale initiatieven
eligibility: local initiatives with social and local benefit
